idea-plugin.name: Easy Snippets
idea-plugin.description:
Saved terminal commands that you run with a shortcut, in the classic and in the new terminal, including SSH session tabs.

  • Every command is stored as description - command
  • Commands can live in folders (nested folders too) or at the top level without any folder
  • Mark commands as favourites and press the shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E by default) to open a popup with them; type to filter, Enter to run
  • Create a chained command from several selected commands
  • Give a command or folder a shortcut of its own with Assign Shortcut; only those commands are listed in Settings | Keymap
  • Select several commands and group them into a folder
  • Run several commands one after another: a folder, a selection, or a command with several lines. The next command starts when the previous one has finished, also over SSH and through sudo su: the plugin waits for the prompt and never types into a command that asks for input
  • Optionally stop the sequence when a command fails
  • Commands that are only pasted into the prompt, so you can finish them by hand
  • Switch between an SSH terminal tab and the file tree of the same host in Remote Host, and back

Manage the commands in View | Tool Windows | Easy Snippets.

action.description: Show the favourite terminal commands and run the chosen one
